tasks.title: preprocess: write an opt-in FOV mask per aligned plan series
tasks.test_approach: TDD in tests/test_preprocess.py with the existing synthetic plan/series fixtures (SYNTHETIC_ ids, built at test time), via run_plan(tmp_path, [mr_spec(...)], steps=replace(SMALL, series_fov_mask=True)) — SMALL, never the full LEGACY_RNT 701x701x433 grid; 'LEGACY_RNT' in the criteria only names the step set. Assert on the mask read back from disk. Run each new test against the unchanged code first and confirm it fails.
criteria: PreprocessSteps gains series_fov_mask: bool = False; it is not a step: preprocess() with only series_fov_mask on raises ValueError(REASON_NO_STEPS) and out_root does not exist (add PreprocessSteps(series_fov_mask=True) to the loop in test_no_step_on_raises_before_any_write_even_with_linear_masks); the preprocess_series no-step check needs no code change (spec M1, AC5).

With series_fov_mask on, a plan with one registered MR (constant small integer v > 0, a pure translation rigid(0, ...) partly outside the CT) under replace(SMALL, series_fov_mask=True) writes fovmask_<MR output name>: uint8, with size, origin, spacing and direction equal to the final CT output's header read back from disk; over all voxels (mask == 1) == (MR output != 0) and MR output[mask == 1] == v exactly; the mask holds both 0s and 1s (spec AC1). Do not reuse coverage()'s interior band or 1e-4 tolerance; this exact-equality clause is never loosened.

The mask is the nearest-neighbour resample of an all-ones uint8 copy of the series with the series' transform (the image covers_ct builds), never derived from series values; covers_ct builds the image and computes has_voxels inside its quiet_call, returning both, so coverage is has_voxels of that same image (spec M3, vault [[sitk-fov-overlap-by-resampling-an-all-ones-mask]]).
The plan row's files lists the mask right after its series; the output series.csv has no mask row (spec M4, AC2).

Under replace(SMALL, rescale=False, series_fov_mask=True), a registered CT series of constant -1000 HU (so its fill, its minimum, is nonzero) on the same native grid and reg_matrix as the MR gets a mask array equal to the MR's mask array (spec AC2).
A series left out (reg_matrix '', no overlap, unreadable file) gets no fovmask_ file and skipped_series is unchanged (spec AC3).

With series_fov_mask off (default and LEGACY_RNT), no fovmask_ file is written and every existing test passes unchanged (spec AC4). Review check, not tested: with the option off the mask image is released right after the coverage check, not held through process_series (spec M6).
With the option on, study series, dose and mask outputs and the aligned series' values are unchanged (spec AC7).
Guardrail: no sitk.GetArrayViewFromImage of a temporary image (vault [[simpleitk-array-view-of-temporary-image-reads-freed-memory]]); bind the image to a name or use GetArrayFromImage.
Guardrail: the mask build and write run inside quiet_call / the existing write path, so an unexpected error is REASON_INTERNAL; no raise inside an except block.

tasks.title: CLI: preprocess --series-fov-mask
tasks.test_approach: In tests/test_cli.py, monkeypatch cli.preprocess to record its steps (as the calls fixture does) and assert on them; add ['--series-fov-mask'] to the flags loop of test_preprocess_without_the_preset_exits_1_with_no_steps. The --series-fov-mask help says it needs --legacy-rnt and covers aligned plan series only.
criteria: `preprocess --legacy-rnt --series-fov-mask` passes steps == replace(LEGACY_RNT, series_fov_mask=True) to preprocess, and with --legacy-linear-masks too both fields are set (spec AC5).
`preprocess --series-fov-mask` without --legacy-rnt exits 1 with REASON_NO_STEPS and creates no output root (spec AC5).
Without the flag, steps.series_fov_mask is False.

tasks.title: manifest: fov_mask key on aligned series entries
tasks.test_approach: In tests/test_manifest.py, preprocess a synthetic plan with a registered MR with and without series_fov_mask, then run manifest on each output tree and on the converted tree.
criteria: On a tree preprocessed with series_fov_mask, the plan's series entry is {"file": <MR output>, "modality": "MR", "fov_mask": "fovmask_<MR output>"}, keyed on the file fovmask_<series file> existing in the plan folder, with no header read of the mask (spec M5, AC6).
On a tree preprocessed without it, the entry is exactly {"file", "modality"} as today; converted-tree and imaging-row manifests are unchanged; existing manifest tests pass unchanged (spec AC6).

guardrails: Merge (2.10): profile merge is squash; use gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit <head> only after the Codex state comment's commit_sha equals the head SHA and the GraphQL query shows no unresolved Codex threads. Never a local git merge onto main.
Pre-push (vault Memory/rt-dataprep/pre-push-uses-stale-dotvenv-pytest): the pre-push gate runs .venv/bin/pytest; run `uv run --group dev pytest -q` first so .venv has the dev group.

No CI in this repo; commit gate at most 5 staged files; no raise inside an except block; PHI: log counts and REASON_ constants only, test data SYNTHETIC_; use uv run; no GetArrayViewFromImage of a temporary; no arithmetic on a 4D float test image.
Closing keyword: the PR body uses 'Closes #129' so the issue closes on merge.
